mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rooms (id, group_id, name, description, game_name, password_hash, owner_user_id, open_state, lifecycle, current_activity_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{gameName}, #{passwordHash}, #{ownerUserId}, #{openState}, #{lifecycle}, #{currentActivityId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rooms WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY name, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activities (id, room_id, activity_generation, state, started_at, ended_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{roomId}, #{activityGeneration}, #{state}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activities WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND state = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE activities SET activity_generation = #{activityGeneration}, state = #{state}, ended_at = #{endedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
